verses.original: תְּפִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הַטֵּֽה־ אָזְנְךָ֣ יְהוָ֣ה עֲנֵ֑נִי כִּֽי־ אָֽנִי׃ עָנִ֖י וְאֶבְי֣וֹן
verses.transliteration: tə·p̄il·lāh lə·ḏā·wiḏ haṭ·ṭêh- ’ā·zə·nə·ḵā Yah·weh ‘ă·nê·nî kî- ’ā·nî ‘ā·nî wə·’eḇ·yō·wn
verses.literal: A prayer of David Incline Your ear O LORD and answer me for I am poor and needy

verses.original: שָֽׁמְרָ֣ה נַפְשִׁי֮ כִּֽי־ אָ֥נִי חָסִ֪יד אַתָּ֣ה אֱלֹהַ֑י הוֹשַׁ֣ע עַ֭בְדְּךָ הַבּוֹטֵ֥חַ אֵלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šā·mə·rāh nap̄·šî kî- ’ā·nî ḥā·sîḏ ’at·tāh ’ĕ·lō·hay hō·wō·ša‘ ‘aḇ·də·ḵā hab·bō·w·ṭê·aḥ ’ê·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Preserve my soul for I [am] godly You are my God save Your servant who trusts in You

verses.original: חָנֵּ֥נִי אֲדֹנָ֑י כִּ֥י אֶ֝קְרָ֗א אֵלֶ֥יךָ כָּל־ הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.literal: Be merciful to me O Lord for I call to You all day long

verses.original: שַׂ֭מֵּחַ נֶ֣פֶשׁ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ כִּ֥י אֵלֶ֥יךָ אֲ֝דֹנָ֗י אֶשָּֽׂא׃ נַפְשִׁ֥י
verses.literal: Bring joy vvv to Your servant for to You O Lord I lift up my soul

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי ט֣וֹב וְסַלָּ֑ח וְרַב־ חֶ֝֗סֶד לְכָל־ קֹרְאֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’at·tāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy ṭō·wḇ wə·sal·lāḥ wə·raḇ- ḥe·seḏ lə·ḵāl qō·rə·’e·ḵā
verses.literal: For You O Lord are kind and forgiving rich in loving devotion to all who call on You

verses.original: הַאֲזִ֣ינָה תְּפִלָּתִ֑י יְ֭הוָה וְ֝הַקְשִׁ֗יבָה בְּק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנוֹתָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ă·zî·nāh tə·p̄il·lā·ṯî Yah·weh wə·haq·šî·ḇāh bə·qō·wl ta·ḥă·nū·nō·w·ṯāy
verses.literal: Hear my prayer O LORD and attend to my plea for mercy
In the day of my distress I call on You because You answer me

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֗י אֵין־ כָּמ֖וֹךָ בָאֱלֹהִ֥ים׀ וְאֵ֣ין כְּֽמַעֲשֶֽׂיךָ׃
verses.literal: O Lord [there is] none like You among the gods nor any works like Yours

verses.original: כָּל־ גּוֹיִ֤ם׀ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֗יתָ יָב֤וֹאוּ׀ וְיִשְׁתַּחֲו֣וּ לְפָנֶ֣יךָ אֲדֹנָ֑י וִֽיכַבְּד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- gō·w·yim ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯā yā·ḇō·w·’ū wə·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ’ă·ḏō·nāy wî·ḵab·bə·ḏū liš·me·ḵā
verses.literal: All the nations - You have made will come and bow before You O Lord and they will glorify Your name

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אַ֭תָּה גָד֣וֹל וְעֹשֵׂ֣ה נִפְלָא֑וֹת אַתָּ֖ה לְבַדֶּֽךָ׃ אֱלֹהִ֣ים
verses.literal: For You are great and perform wonders You alone are God

verses.original: ה֘וֹרֵ֤נִי דַּרְכֶּ֗ךָ יְהוָ֨ה׀ אֲהַלֵּ֥ךְ בַּאֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ יַחֵ֥ד לְ֝בָבִ֗י לְיִרְאָ֥ה שְׁמֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·rê·nî dar·ke·ḵā Yah·weh ’ă·hal·lêḵ ba·’ă·mit·te·ḵā ya·ḥêḏ lə·ḇā·ḇî lə·yir·’āh šə·me·ḵā
verses.literal: Teach me Your way O LORD that I may walk in Your truth Give me an undivided heart that I may fear Your name

verses.original: אוֹדְךָ֤׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּכָל־ לְבָבִ֑י וַאֲכַבְּדָ֖ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.literal: I will praise You O Lord my God with all my heart I will glorify Your name forever

verses.original: כִּֽי־ גָּד֣וֹל חַ֭סְדְּךָ עָלָ֑י וְהִצַּ֥לְתָּ נַ֝פְשִׁ֗י תַּחְתִּיָּֽה׃ מִשְּׁא֥וֹל
verses.transliteration: kî- gā·ḏō·wl ḥas·də·ḵā ‘ā·lāy wə·hiṣ·ṣal·tā nap̄·šî taḥ·tî·yāh miš·šə·’ō·wl
verses.literal: For great is Your loving devotion to me You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol

verses.original: זֵ֘דִ֤ים קָֽמוּ־ עָלַ֗י אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ וַעֲדַ֣ת עָ֭רִיצִים בִּקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א שָׂמ֣וּךָ לְנֶגְדָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zê·ḏîm qā·mū- ‘ā·lay ’ĕ·lō·hîm wa·‘ă·ḏaṯ ‘ā·rî·ṣîm biq·šū nap̄·šî wə·lō śā·mū·ḵā lə·neḡ·dām
verses.literal: The arrogant rise against me O God a band of ruthless men seeks my life they have no regard for You

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי רַח֣וּם וְחַנּ֑וּן אֵל־ אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וְרַב־ חֶ֥סֶד וֶאֱמֶֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy ra·ḥūm wə·ḥan·nūn ’êl- ’e·reḵ ’ap·pa·yim wə·raḇ- ḥe·seḏ we·’ĕ·meṯ
verses.literal: But You O Lord are a compassionate and gracious God slow to anger abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness

verses.original: פְּנֵ֥ה אֵלַ֗י וְחָ֫נֵּ֥נִי תְּנָֽה־ עֻזְּךָ֥ לְעַבְדֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝הוֹשִׁ֗יעָה לְבֶן־ אֲמָתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: pə·nêh ’ê·lay wə·ḥān·nê·nî tə·nāh- ‘uz·zə·ḵā lə·‘aḇ·de·ḵā wə·hō·wō·šî·‘āh lə·ḇen- ’ă·mā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Turn to me and have mercy grant Your strength to Your servant save the son of Your maidservant

verses.original: עֲשֵֽׂה־ עִמִּ֥י א֗וֹת לְט֫וֹבָ֥ה שֹׂנְאַ֣י וְיִרְא֣וּ וְיֵבֹ֑שׁוּ כִּֽי־ אַתָּ֥ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה עֲזַרְתַּ֥נִי וְנִחַמְתָּֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·śêh- ‘im·mî ’ō·wṯ lə·ṭō·w·ḇāh śō·nə·’ay wə·yir·’ū wə·yê·ḇō·šū kî- ’at·tāh Yah·weh ‘ă·zar·ta·nî wə·ni·ḥam·tā·nî
verses.literal: Show me a sign of Your goodness that my enemies may see and be ashamed for You O LORD have helped me and comforted me
